Display the resting time and feeding schedule. If any dogs are dropped, issue a heartfelt thanks to the retiring athletes. If a blizzard condition is noted in the checkpoint data, display a survival gear check alert. Report the departure into the wilderness. Conclude by announcing the triumphant arrival under the burled arch in Nome and the final vet check. Example input: a list with Nikolai, four, one.

title: Casino Roulette Wheel Spin
spec: Develop a function `roulette(bets)` that simulates a table dealer during a casino game. The input is a list of three item tuples containing the player name, the bet type like a specific number or color, and the wager amount. Announce the clearing of the table, the shuffling of the chips, and the loud call for no more bets. Display the spin of the wheel and the ball bouncing across the wooden pockets. Randomly determine or hardcode a winning number and color, and announce the result loudly. Iterate through the bets. For winners, display a congratulatory payout message and the stack of chips pushed forward. For losers, display a collection message and the sweeping of the board. Example input: a list with Alice, red, fifty.

title: Bird Banding Station
spec: Create a function `band(birds)` that logs the daily activities of an ornithology research station. The input is a list of three item tuples with the bird species, its weight in grams, and its estimated age. Announce the mist nets being opened at dawn and the quiet waiting period. For each bird, report the delicate extraction from the fine net. Display the species identification and log the attachment of the numbered metal leg band. Report the weight measurement and blowing on the feathers to check the age. Finally, display a joyful message as the bird is released back into the wild. Conclude the day by announcing the nets closing and data entry. Example input: a list with robin, seventy, adult.

title: Tornado Intercept Mission
spec: Implement a function `chase(observations)` that narrates a severe weather tracking expedition. The input is a list of two item tuples detailing the weather event and the estimated distance in miles. Announce the departure from the meteorology base, the radar activation, and the radio check. For each observation, if the event is a wall cloud, display a rotation monitoring alert. If it is a funnel, report the rapid descent. If it is a touchdown, declare a tornadic emergency. If the event includes large hail, issue a vehicle damage warning. If the distance is under two miles, issue an immediate safety warning to fall back. Announce the safe return to base after the storm dissipates and the data upload completion. Example input: a list with funnel cloud, three.

title: Cross Country Paragliding
spec: Write a function `paraglide(thermals)` that logs a free flight journey through the skies. The input is a list of two item tuples containing the lift rate in meters per second and the wind drift direction. Announce the running launch off the mountain peak, the canopy inflating, and the harness seating. For each thermal encountered, display the banking turn into the rising air. If the lift rate is high, report a rapid altitude gain and soaring with eagles. If the lift rate is low, display a struggle to maintain height. Report the transition glide to the next cloud street. Conclude by announcing the landing approach, the flare out, and a gentle touchdown in the valley. Example input: a list with three, north.

title: Quarter Mile Drag Race
spec: Create a function `dragrace(stages)` that commentates a high horsepower acceleration run. The input is a list of two item tuples with the track distance marker and the current speed in miles per hour. Announce the water box burnout, the tire smoke, and the careful staging at the starting line. Display the yellow bulbs dropping and the sudden green light launch. As the car passes each distance marker, report the fierce acceleration and the engine RPM shifting. If the speed exceeds two hundred, issue a supersonic speed alert. Conclude by announcing the finish line timing trap, the parachute deployment, and the final elapsed time. Example input: a list with sixty feet, sixty.

title: Tour de France Stage
spec: Develop a function `peloton(events)` that narrates a professional cycling race. The input is a list of three item tuples indicating the race kilometer, the event type such as breakaway or sprint, and the time gap in seconds. Announce the neutral roll out, the official flag drop, and the early pace setting. For each event, if it is a breakaway, report the attacking riders and the expanding time gap. If it is a categorized climb, display the grinding gear shifts, the heavy breathing, and the mountain points awarded. If it is an intermediate sprint, report the fast twitch muscle action. Announce the frantic final kilometer lead out and the stage winner crossing the line with arms raised. Example input: a list with ten, breakaway, thirty.

title: Knitting Pattern Generator
spec: Implement a function `knit(rows)` that dictates a cozy scarf creation process. The input is a list of two item tuples containing the fabric side and the stitch sequence. Announce the gathering of the yarn, the needle selection, and the initial cast on of stitches. For each row, report the row number progress. If it is the right side, display instructions to keep the tension tight and the pattern visible. If it is the wrong side, instruct to purl the stitches and carry the yarn in front. If a color change is required in the sequence, report the tying of the new yarn. Conclude by announcing the final bind off, the weaving of loose ends, and the wet blocking of the finished piece. Example input: a list with right side, knit two purl two.

title: Wooden Cabinet Assembly
spec: Write a function `cabinet(parts)` that guides a woodworker through building furniture. The input is a list of two item tuples detailing the panel name and the joinery method. Announce the unpacking of the flat box, the inventory check of the hardware, and the workspace clearing. For each part, display the alignment of the wooden edges. If the method is wood glue, report the application of an even bead and the twenty minute clamping time. If the method is pocket screws, display the drilling action and the snug fit. Announce the attachment of the swinging door hinges. Finally, report the application of the finishing oil, the buffing, and the completed build. Example input: a list with side panel, wood glue.

title: T Shirt Screen Printing
spec: Develop a function `screenprint(layers)` that tracks the production of graphic apparel. The input is a list of two item tuples with the ink color and the mesh screen count. Announce the emulsion coating, the dark room exposure of the screens, and the press setup. For each color layer, report the loading of the shirt onto the platen. Display the heavy squeegee pull spreading the ink across the stencil. If the mesh count is high, report the precise capture of fine halftone details. After each layer, announce the brief flash curing under the heat lamp. Conclude by reporting the final run through the conveyor dryer and folding the fresh garment. Example input: a list with white base, one hundred.

title: Leather Wallet Stitching
spec: Create a function `leather(pieces)` that logs the craftsmanship of a handmade accessory. The input is a list of two item tuples containing the leather section and the thickness in ounces. Announce the rolling out of the premium hide, the grain inspection, and the precise pattern tracing. For each piece, report the sharp blade cutting the shape. If the thickness is above four ounces, issue a note to use extra pressure on the skiving knife to thin the edges. Display the hammering of the pricking irons to create perfectly spaced stitching holes. Report the rhythmic figure eight saddle stitching using waxed thread. Announce the edge burnishing, the beeswax application, and the final product inspection. Example input: a list with card pocket, three.

title: Fencing Bout Scoring
spec: Implement a function `fencing(touches)` that referees a fast paced sword fighting match. The input is a list of three item tuples detailing the attacking fencer, the blade action, and whether the hit was on valid target area. Announce the traditional salute, the masks going down, and the call to en garde. For each touch, reconstruct the action by reporting the parry, the riposte, or the deep lunge. If the hit is valid, display the awarding of a point, the flashing colored light, and update the score. If off target, announce a halt with a white light and no point given. Conclude by announcing the match point, the final score, and the traditional post bout handshake. Example input: a list with left fencer, lunge, valid.

title: Sailplane Tow and Release
spec: Write a function `sailplane(flight)` that narrates an unpowered glider flight. The input is a list of two item tuples with the flight maneuver and the current altitude in feet. Announce the tow rope connection, the wing runner signaling level, and the bumpy grass takeoff roll behind the tow plane. Display the loud release bang as the glider detaches and the immediate quiet of the cockpit. For each maneuver, if it is circling, report the tight bank angle inside the invisible thermal updraft. If it is ridge soaring, display the smooth cruising along the mountain contour. Announce the popping of the airbrakes on the final approach, the flare, and the quiet touchdown on the runway.
